title: Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.18 (the two-mode design-system slot) is pinned on its published parts, and every place that names a Tracy Business version agrees
steps: S1: read tracy-business/emdash in apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json and packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/provision/quickstarts.json.
S2: read version of packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/package.json, template.config.json and the Dockerfile label.
S3: read template-profiles.json releases, the where map emdash-tracy-business.json and packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/emdash-tracy-business.json.
S4: read src/lib/ds-slot.ts and src/layouts/Base.astro of the theme.
expect: S1: both copies pin 1.7.18 on tracy-business-emdash-quickstart-1.7.18.zip (6472598 bytes, sha256 7804bad2...e291, asset 638263593) and tracy-business-emdash-state-1.7.18.tar.gz (8471674 bytes, sha256 974084e6...fc02, asset 638263592).
S3: a 1.7.18 profile row, the where map names 1.7.18, slot maxVersion 1.7.18 with modes true.
S4: ds-slot.ts reads the /* mode: light|dark */ line and Base.astro sets data-theme dark from it.
fence: No stand, no model, no network. The release itself is on JoomlArt-Products/ja-products tag tracy-business/emdash-0.x; this case reads only the repo.
